description.en: Sets or clears a global bit flag, one of the 2560 story and progress flags (numbers 0 to 2559). Without a second argument the flag is set. The flags live in the game's flag data (part of the save data). A number outside that range makes the game report an error, and the bit is still written past the table.
true to set the flag, false to clear it.

true (also when the flag data is not available and nothing is written).
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Marking progress after the tutorials (real usage, from ev42010100.nut)
Clearing a flag (real usage, from ev42061300.nut)
